goal: Search popular and trending open-source GitHub repositories sorted by stars
explanation: GitHub repository search endpoint returning top-starred open-source repositories, star/fork counts, primary language, and topics.

dynamic_params.name: query
dynamic_params.description: Repository search query or topic (e.g. 'mcp server', 'browser agent', 'llm')

dynamic_params.name: limit
dynamic_params.description: Maximum number of repositories to return (default: 5)
